findings.explanation: Payment terms of Net 90 require you to wait three months to receive payment, creating a severe cash flow burden.
findings.suggested_change: Invoices are payable Net 30 from the date of invoice.

findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Ownership of your work passes to the client upon delivery before you are guaranteed full payment, leaving you unprotected if the client fails to pay.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to Client only upon receipt of full payment of all fees due under this Agreement.

findings.quoted_text: Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: Only the client has the right to terminate without cause, with immediate effect, and without paying for work already completed.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time without cause upon 30 days written notice, and Client shall pay Contractor for all Services performed up to the effective date of termination.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause on payment terms, waiting three months for payment creates a cash flow challenge, so I propose modifying it so that invoices are payable Net 30 from the date of invoice. - Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, ownership currently passes upon delivery before payment is guaranteed, so I propose that all intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to Client only upon receipt of full payment of all fees due under this Agreement. - Regarding the relevant clause on termination, the current terms allow termination without notice or payment for completed work, so I propose that either party may terminate this Agreement at any time without cause upon 30 days written notice, and Client shall pay Contractor for all Services performed up to the effective date of termination. Thank you for your time and understanding. Best regards,
